rules.entry: each fixed asset at first01:00UTCopen; long spot, equal-net-base short perpetual; no funding forecasts or timing
rules.holding: fixed base quantity without rebalancing until last23:00UTCopen before phase end, unless known-hour margin-equity/notional<=20percent or portfolio marked drawdown>=5percent triggers next-hour whole-book exit
rules.funding: actual events with original millisecond clock; entry<event<=exit; mark at containing-hour open is explicitly a settlement proxy
rules.fee_inventory: spot entry fee charged in base with gross=q/(1-fee), spot exit fee in quote; exact same net q short perp; continuous quantities at initial economic screen
rules.capital: each asset25percent spot,70percent isolated short collateral,5percent reserve; no borrowing or external deposits
rules.sampling: full hourly NAV; all complete calendar month returns including marked inventory; one continuous account per scenario
